name: agentic-coding-loop
description: The continuous-improvement loop: a persistent state file, a round protocol, and invariants that survive context resets.

plugins.name: loop
plugins.description: Run the improvement loop in a repository: bootstrap the LOOP_STATE.md spine, run a falsifiable round against it, audit a claim, or send a learning upstream. The protocol is LOOP.md; every skill inlines it.

plugins.name: loop-ux-roast
plugins.displayName: Agentic Coding Loop — UX Roast domain
plugins.description: Optional domain layer for the agentic coding loop, for user-facing products doing continuous UX-driven improvement: a coverage map keyed by surface, verification at scale for multi-complaint roast passes, and parallelized maker+checker fixes for disjoint findings. Additive to core §E, never a replacement; requires the core `loop` plugin.
